Snapshot all objects into a single compressed artifact (.csnap) for version
control.

Writes the tip to --snapshot-file (committed in git). Before overwrite, copies the
previous tip into an external backup directory and keeps only the newest N priors.
Backup location/keep: --backup-dir/--backup-keep, else config/zqk.yaml kernel_state.snapshot_backup_*,
else <parent>/<repo>-csnap-backups keep=3. Refuses a large shrink unless --allow-shrink.

  Commit system state
  zqk system state-commit

Usage:
  zqk system state-commit [flags]

Flags:
      --allow-shrink            Allow writing a tip csnap with far fewer objects than the previous tip
      --backup-dir string       External prior-tip backup dir (overrides config/zqk.yaml kernel_state.snapshot_backup_dir)
      --backup-keep int         Prior tip copies to keep (0 = use settings or default 3)
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --skip-archive            Do not copy the previous tip into the external backup dir before overwrite
      --snapshot-file string    Tip path written for git (single file) (default ".zqk-state/system-state.csnap")
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
